core_obligations: Statement (lines 5685-5695): with notation and assumptions as in Lemma lemma-tensor-hom-adjoint, assume (1) N defines a compact object of D(B, d) and (2) the map H^k(A) -> Hom in D(B, d) from N to N[k] is an isomorphism for all k; then - tensor_A^L N is fully faithful.

Adjunction reduction (proof lines 5697-5706): the functor has left adjoint RHom(N, -) by Lemma lemma-tensor-hom-adjoint; by the standard Categories adjoint lemma it suffices to show the unit map M -> RHom(N, M tensor_A^L N) is an isomorphism in D(A, d) for every differential graded A-module M.

Cohomology reduction (lines 5707-5710): by Lemma lemma-derived-restriction-exts it suffices to show H^n(M) -> Ext^n in D(B, d) from N to M tensor_A^L N is an isomorphism; since N is compact the right hand side commutes with direct sums.

Property (P) induction and shift case (lines 5711-5717): by Remark remark-P-resolution it suffices to treat M = A[k]; by Remark remark-shift-tensor-no-sign A[k] tensor_A^L N = N[k], and assumption (2) is exactly the required isomorphism for these.
proof_roadmap: Pass to the unit of the Tensor-Hom adjunction via the adjoint fully-faithful criterion.
Reformulate on cohomology as an Ext statement and use compactness of N to commute with direct sums.
Reduce along property (P) resolutions to the shifts A[k], where assumption (2) gives the result.
difficulty_reason: Fully-faithfulness lemma (statement 5685-5695, proof 5697-5718): derived tensor with a compact bimodule satisfying the H^k(A) identification is fully faithful - the proof is the standard four-step reduction (adjoint unit, cohomology/Ext reformulation, compactness, property (P) resolution down to shifts), each step stated with its justification and closed by hypothesis (2); no architectural step is omitted. H2: reduction chain with compactness input.
